title: Hedge reduction for a Sidney condo

seo.title: Sample project: Sidney condo hedge reduction | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: an overgrown hedge at a Sidney condo reduced in two stages a year apart, with Town rules checked and neighbours told first.

summary: An overgrown boundary hedge reduced in stages over two seasons.
challenge: A boundary hedge had grown over the sidewalk and was shading the ground-floor units.
approach: We checked the Town of Sidney's tree rules first, then planned the reduction in two stages a year apart, so the hedge would green up again instead of leaving bare stems.
Neighbours were told before each visit, and the cuttings were chipped and removed.
result: Sidewalk cleared and the hedge kept as a screen.
